description: Land Title Settlement Department - Millawa, Neluwa D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810680 (24/0068)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the Commissioner's determination regarding title to specific land parcels (Nos. 1:73 and 1:87) in Galle District. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extent, owner names, identity numbers, title class, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land and property-related matters falling under Type 4 classification.
